narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The cube has square faces, so its shadow always gives a square.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Tip the dice, and two faces can catch the sunlight together.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows a square shadow for every position; the dice tips and two faces glow; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, hold a dice or a small box in sunlight over paper.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turn it slowly, and trace the outline of its shadow each time.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Every outline you trace should have four sides or six sides.
removed_beats.on_screen: the three shadows sit side by side with their face counts one, two and three

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says a cube has square faces, so its shadow always gives a square. Turn it, and two or three faces catch the sun, which changes the outline.
